rules.text: A change to subheadings 3001.20 through 3001.90 from any other subheading.
A change to subheadings 3002.11 through 3002.19 from any other subheading outside that group.
A change to subheadings 3002.20 through 3003.39 from any other subheading.
A change to subheadings 3003.41 through 3003.49 from any other subheading outside that group.
A change to subheadings 3003.60 through 3003.90 from any other subheading outside that group.
A change to heading 3004 from any other heading, provided that the change in heading does not result exclusively from packaging for retail sale.
A change to subheadings 3005.10 through 3006.40 from any other subheading.

A change to subheading 3006.50 from any other subheading, provided that there is a regional value content of not less than:
(A) 35 percent under the build-up method; or
(B) 45 percent under the build-down method.
A change to subheadings 3006.60 through 3006.92 from any other subheading.
